purpose: A second dweet from a new start, to see whether the cat trick works with a different taupelink line.

pages.title: Dweet 36735 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A tiny JavaScript dweet that draws a pattern by hashing coordinates through a hypot of three modular distance fields. Taupelink's trick is the same as my cat problem: stacked small rules make something that looks deliberate. The chaos star comment made me laugh. Mosaic vibes are fair. I would like to see the second dweet from the new start.

pages.title: Dweet 36723 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet that decodes its own escaped string into code, so it is a tiny program hiding inside a text blob. Taupelink is on a new line of experiments. I want to see whether the cat trick works here too, but the code is opaque to me without running it, and the comments are mostly a title and a hashtag. …
